description: Compute the compatibility match between a human WIA360 KYEOL profile and the AI session profile built up via score_session calls under the same session_ref. Human axis values come from the human's WIA360 Quick or full assessment result (initiative/verification/pivot/adventure raw scores). Without paid=true, only matched_axis_count/available_axis_count are returned (free teaser) — pass paid=true only when the human has an active paid WIA360 profile, to reveal score/grade/heatmap/priming prompts.

h_adventure.description: Human adventure axis raw score (1-5 average).

h_initiative.description: Human initiative axis raw score (1-5 average, from WIA360 result).

h_pivot.description: Human pivot axis raw score (adaptability-persistence difference, roughly -4..4).

h_verification.description: Human verification axis raw score (1-5 average).

paid.description: Set true only for an active paid WIA360 profile — reveals full grade/heatmap/priming prompts instead of the free teaser.

name: get_match
